methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Prusa Research is a bootstrapped frontier-tech company operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector. The valuation universe consists of 9 comparable companies: 1 public peer (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains 8 private comparables, but the target's bootstrapped stage and idiosyncratic scale do not yield three or more peers meeting stage-matched or adjacent-stage filters. Applying an all-sector median would conflate companies across materially different funding maturity levels and burn profiles, introducing unacceptable estimation error. No triangulated valuation output emerged from the available methodologies.

The absence of sufficient same-stage and tier-matched peers represents the primary analytical constraint. Without validated multiples from a credible peer subset, this analysis cannot responsibly propose a point estimate or range. Further valuation work would require either (1) access to transaction data or secondary equity pricing for subset peers, (2) bottoms-up revenue or margin modeling if financial detail is available, or (3) expansion of the comp set to include adjacent sectors (software-enabled manufacturing, industrial automation) at the risk of reduced precision. Current data does not support quantitative synthesis.
